meta.labelNote: All labels decimal. Code labels are frame numbers inside compound bank 22000; most are runStart+1 of their sequence run (engine resolves the containing run). 'run' below = [firstFrame, lastFrame] of the containing sequence in compound_22000.json.

flags.s44: obj+0x44 current state label (dispatch key; may differ from the sequence actually queued - this builds the heading ladder)
flags.s48: obj+0x48 'scripted' flag: 1 = dispatch next boundary on s44; 0 = next boundary rolls a fresh label from the per-kind picker (s44 ignored)
flags.s4a: obj+0x4a 'interruptible/plain-flight' flag: 1 = plain loop, 0 = in special act (query fn 0x1a444 returns s4a==0)
flags.s4c: obj+0x4c 'not started' flag: 1 = suppress compound advance (only set by ctor, cleared at launch)

meta.invocation: GiveTime (0x18697) state 2/3 -> 0x1886b each 10Hz tick: die (state 3) if bbox fully past LEFT screen edge (0x179e7) or fully below BOTTOM edge (0x17a43); else if ctl byte +0x4a set (sequence queue needs refill) run the transition handler 0x188cf, then ctl vtbl+0x94, then advance compound if s4c==0.
meta.death: No sequence ends the object; toasters live until they drift off the left or bottom screen edge.
meta.adultFlag: obj+0x58, copied at spawn from ToasterControl+0x82c: 1 = adult song mode, 0 = baby song mode.

launch.spawn: pos = 0x4171ad(compound) random spawn point; if x==-1000 or y==-1000 stay in state 1 and retry next tick. obj+0x38=pos, obj+0x64=compound.currentStore, obj+0x5c=now() after start.

kinds.roll: 0x19d8d: if adult (+0x58!=0) r=RandShort(11): r==0 -> kind 3, r in 1..5 -> kind 2, r in 6..10 -> kind 1. If baby (+0x58==0) always kind 3.

1.start: 0x1a3ea(obj, 3, pos): queueWithGlue(3), s44=3, s48=0, s4a=1, s4c=0, MoveTo(pos)

2.start: 0x1a3ea(obj, 93, pos): queueWithGlue(93), s44=93, s48=0, s4a=1, s4c=0, MoveTo(pos)

3.start983: 0x1a3ea(obj, 983, pos): queue [983], s48=0, s4a=1, s4c=0, MoveTo(pos)
3.startSpecial: 0x1a276(obj, L, pos): queueWithGlue(L), s48=1, s4a=0, s4c=0, MoveTo(pos), then per-label overrides:

1107.pos: x = screen.right + 40, y = screen.top + 200 + RandShort(max(1, screenHeight-200))
1107.note: enters from right edge; plays 1107 then long act 1065 (39 frames), state stays 1107

1111.note: enters from below, near horizontal center

2391.note: anchored to a ToasterControl point (+0x44/+0x46), not the random spawn pos

pickers.comment: At each queue-empty boundary, if s48==0 the dispatch label is freshly rolled here (current s44 ignored); if s48==1 dispatch uses s44.

3.cond: default case (label 3 has no explicit case)
3.note: falls to kind1 default: see defaults.kind1

93.cond: default case (label 93 has no explicit case)

1009.note: fresh pick from kind3 picker (1/80): loop 3x

1014.note: ladder down: play 1025, state 1009. NO jump to end - falls into second roll below (both can fire)
if both rolls hit, net queue = [1025, 1014] and s44 = 1014

1019.note: swoop pair, then release to picker (s48=0)

988.note: wander among the three loops uniformly

983.note: falls to kind3 default: 95% requeue 983 via picker path; 1.25% each enter 988/1009/1014/1019 cases with s48==0

1038.note: locked act: repeats until offscreen death

1111.note: after entry act 1111, hand off to plain flight 983; next boundary hits 983 (no case) -> default

1138.note: UNREACHABLE: kind3 picker never returns 1138, so the !s48 flavor is dead code. Raw condition fields obj+0x2c/+0x1c/+0x64 unidentified.
dead code: falls into 1154 case body

2391.note: UNREACHABLE dead code (picker never returns 2391 with s48==0), so the unique-act flag 0x43a072 is never actually set at runtime; it is only cleared in dtor/retire (0x18540/0x18647) when dying with s44==2391
dead code: falls into 1038 case body

48.cond: reached as state after exit act; no case

607.cond: state after exit act; s48=0 so fresh pick anyway

643.cond: state after exit act; s48=0 so fresh pick anyway

defaults.comment: Reached when no case fired (si==0). Guard g = 0x1987f(obj, L) simulates half then full step (quarter step for label 3) of L's travel delta from ctl anchor +0x44; nonzero result = offscreen edge object, passed to recovery 0x1948a.

kind1.recovery: 0x1948a kind1: mask=DirMask(obj->edge) (0x19f5e), e=edge->vtbl+0x24(); if mask&1||e try 133, then 172, then 209 (each: queueWithGlue, s48=0, s4a=1); else if mask&1 turn-around: s44 := (s44 in {115,105} ? 115 : 105), raw-queue s44; else if e s44:=3 and raw-queue; else raw-requeue current s44

kind2.recovery: 0x1948a kind2: if mask&1||e: if mask&4 try 252 then 231 else try 231 then 252 (queueWithGlue, s48=0, s4a=1); else if mask&1 turn-around: if s44 in {115,105} then s44:=115 AND kind:=1 else s44:=105, raw-queue; else if e s44:=93 raw-queue; else raw-requeue current

kind3.recovery: 0x1948a kind3: if mask&1 try 1009 (s48=1,s4a=1), then try 1014 (s48=1,s4a=1); else s44:=983, s48=0, s4a=1, queueWithGlue(983)

glue.queueWithGlue (0x19cc1): if s44 in {115, 105} and target not in {115, 122}: queue [122, target]; else queue [target]. Then s44 := target. 105/115 = turn-around sequences, 122 = turn-completion glue.
glue.queueList (0x19d10): same glue test applied to FIRST label only (via ctl vtbl+0x80/0x7c); remaining labels appended raw (vtbl+0x138); s44 := last label.

notes: Kinds: 1 and 2 are the two ADULT flight families (labels 2..654 in bank 22000; kind roll 0x19d8d gives each 5/11 for adults). Kind 3 is the baby-song family (labels 982..1207 plus 2390..2402); babies are ALWAYS kind 3, and 1-in-11 adult spawns also get kind 3 with plain flight 983 only (specials require +0x58==0). Every code label is verified present in compound_22000.json; most sit at runStart+1 (e.g. 983 in run 982-984, 33 in run 32-44); exact run starts: 1025, 1038, 1065, 1111. Locked special acts (s4a=0) repeat forever and end only by flying off the left/bottom screen edge. The 'unique act' globals 0x43a070 (1138) / 0x43a072 (2391) are cleared on death but the code that would set/check them is unreachable, so uniqueness is not actually enforced in this binary.
